## Description of Changes
<!-- Provide a concise summary of what was added, changed, or fixed -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (SemVer: PATCH)
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (SemVer: MINOR)
- [ ] `feat!` / `BREAKING CHANGE`: Breaking change (SemVer: MAJOR)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Refactoring without functional alteration
- [ ] `perf`: Performance enhancement
- [ ] `chore`: Build configuration, dependency, or tooling updates

## Contributor Checklist
- [ ] Executed and passed `npm run lint`
- [ ] Executed and passed `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] Executed and passed `npm test`
- [ ] Executed and passed `npm run build`
- [ ] Updated [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) under the `[Unreleased]` section
- [ ] Adhered to the UI Zero-Emoji Policy (strictly vector icons via `lucide-react`)
- [ ] Tested functionality on the Vercel Preview URL after bot deployment comment
